title: Space Remix
description: A resourcepack that changes all in-game music with Space Remixes of the same track. All remixes have been done by Anquietas System, so please check them out on YouTube and where-ever else they may be on.
body:
This is a resource pack for Java edition of Minecraft. It replaces all in-game music with spacey feeling remixes of them, plus a few spacey feeling remixes of the music from Galacticraft.

All remixes were created by Anquietas System on YouTube. Many thanks to them for granting permission to make their remixes into a resource pack anyone can use in-game!

The supported versions are 1.10 to 1.12.2. You might be able to use this pack in newer versions, but just know that it only replaces music that was made by C418. So things like Rubedo or whatever wont be touched by this resource pack.

Here's the YouTube playlist containing all the remixes used in this resource pack. I encourage you all to check out their channel! https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLW5coVfBWCl8FNK7wlUJRwoeeZCSX8Upg
